import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD_A = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD_B = 1000000007L;

    static long count = 0;
    static long n_input;
    static long low_sum_value = 0;
    static long result = 0;
    static long[] pwr = new long[8];
    static List<Integer>[] array = new ArrayList[7];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            array[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void generate(int level, long val) {
        long tmp = (count + MOD_A - val % MOD_A) % MOD_A;
        array[level].add((int) tmp);
        low_sum_value = (low_sum_value + tmp) % MOD_B;
        count++;
        if (level < 6) {
            for (int d = 0; d < 10; d++) {
                generate(level + 1, val * 10 + d);
            }
        }
    }

    static void process(int depth, long x) {
        if (x > n_input) return;
        if (x * pwr[6] + pwr[6] - 1 <= n_input && x * pwr[7] > n_input) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long delta = (count + (MOD_A - pwr[i]) * x) % MOD_A;
                int idx = lowerBound(array[i], (int) (MOD_A - delta));
                long sum = (delta + MOD_B - MOD_A) * pwr[i] + MOD_A * idx;
                result = (result + sum) % MOD_B;
            }
            result = (result + low_sum_value) % MOD_B;
            count += 1111111;
            return;
        }
        long temp = (count + MOD_A - x % MOD_A) % MOD_A;
        result = (result + temp) % MOD_B;
        count++;
        int startDigit = (depth == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        for (int i = startDigit; i < 10; i++) {
            process(depth + 1, x * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        pwr[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 7; i++) {
            pwr[i] = pwr[i - 1] * 10;
        }
        generate(0, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(array[i]);
        }
        n_input = sc.nextLong();
        count = 0;
        process(0, 0);
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
